levels.name: First Steps
levels.hint: Walk to the glowing door and step through it. Pick up the coins on the way.

levels.name: Press the Button
levels.hint: The door is locked. Go round the wall, step on the button, then head for the door.

levels.name: Ice & Pond
levels.hint: Water only slows you down and ice makes you slide – neither is dangerous. Reach the door.

levels.name: Acid Hop
levels.hint: Acid is deadly. It is one tile wide – face it and jump (Space) to land on the far side.

levels.name: Spike Row
levels.hint: Spikes pop out of the floor in turns. Wait for a gap – or jump over them.

levels.name: Laser Lane
levels.hint: A laser sweeps back and forth across the room. Cross when it is far away, or jump over the beam.

levels.name: Shock Gate
levels.hint: Each shock charges (yellow) then strikes. Slip through the doorway while the one in your way is idle.

levels.name: Saw & Spinner
levels.hint: Time your run past the patrolling saw, then slip by the spinning bar before the door.

levels.name: Crate Switch
levels.hint: The hold-button only stays pressed while something sits on it. Push the crate along the corridor onto it.

levels.name: Lift Off
levels.hint: Pull the lever (E) to power the lift. Ride it up, jump onto the tower and press the button on top.

levels.name: Grand Exit
levels.hint: Everything so far in one winding room: slide the ice, hop the acid, press the button, time the laser and the shocks.
